numbers.name: exposure_floor
numbers.note: scattered intensity from a two micrometre tracer in this geometry is two decades below brightfield, so the exposure has to grow to match

assumptions.statement: Darkfield collects only scattered light, which for a tracer of this size sits roughly two decades below the transmitted signal; reaching the same signal to noise ratio therefore needs an exposure of order half a second.
assumptions.falsifier: a centroid at the target signal to noise ratio with a shorter darkfield exposure retires this bound
